title: Blinded (Condition)
html:
Not to be confused with Blindness (Condition)

Blinded

  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.

 Blinded

Properties

UID: BLINDED

 Stack ID: BLINDED

 Status groups: SG_Blinded, SG_Condition

 Loses duration: start of turn

 More properties:
  • InitiateCombat
  • Blind

Notes

  • Blinded creatures cannot make Opportunity Attacks
  • Being Blinded has no effect on the range of  Throw or any other action with the IgnoreVisionBlock flag.

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID BLINDED, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Blinded
  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.
Blinded
  • The affected creature has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
  • Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against affected creatures have  Advantage.
  • At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a  Constitution Saving Throw. If successful, the condition is removed.
